scope: Explicit own-output publication eligibility only. No publication action is authorized or performed by this agent. Files absent from this allowlist are excluded, even if placed under the public directory for reviewer convenience.
excluded_classes: Every file under private/: full source bodies, extractions, renders, current registry body.

Unverified audit-time hypothesis and checker: public/KNOWN_INGREDIENT_DERIVATION.md, public/derivation_checker.py, public/derivation_checker_result.json. These are review-only and do not expand the original publication claim.

External/input/runtime records with full local paths and initial seal input record: public/consumed_initial_inputs.json, public/runtime_and_external_inputs.json, public/FIRST_ASSESSMENT_INPUTS.json, public/FIRST_ASSESSMENT_SEAL.json. Their identities can be reported without publishing their local paths.
sanitization: Allowlisted own provenance contains sanitized primary URLs, byte sizes and hashes, no raw HTTP headers, cookies, private account metadata or source bodies.
